name: kb-agents
description: Loads the subagents kb serves (agents/list, agents/get) when a session starts, narrowed by library, category and tag.

url.title: kb URL for agents
url.description: kb's MCP URL, reached directly: agentgateway refuses the agents methods. Empty: no agents load.

library.title: Library
library.description: One library, or empty for all.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Any of these categories. Empty: no category filter.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Any of these entries; tags joined by a comma in one entry must all match. Empty: no tag filter.

agents.title: Agents
agents.description: Only these kb agent names, after the scope. Empty: every agent in scope.

skills.title: Give agents kb skills
skills.description: Connect each agent to kb's skills of its own library, as tools.

skills_url.title: kb URL for skills
skills_url.description: kb's MCP URL for the agents' skills, usually through the gateway. Empty: the agents get no kb skills.

skill_uris.title: skill:// in Bash
skill_uris.description: A Bash command may name a skill's file by its skill:// URI: the mod fetches it into the session's scratchpad and runs that copy.

timeout_ms.title: Timeout (ms)
timeout_ms.description: How long the session's start waits for kb before going on without its agents.
